$comment: detsim-observables/1 (contracts 3.18.0; adapters/detector-simulation, decision D-W1-2 of docs/dev/detector-simulation/PROGRESS.md, TASK.md 9.5): the long table a detector-simulation run hands to hep-statistics, one row per value: quantity name, unit, value as a normalized decimal string (decimal/1), uncertainty type and value, the event or query point, the detector and component when they apply, artifact status labels (e.g. outside-validated-range) and the SHA-256 of the native file the value was read from. runs/<run_id>/observables.csv holds the rows; this schema validates them as JSON objects. Not simulation-summary/1 (per-run accumulators). Code checks (detsim_schemas.check_observables): uncertainty_type none has no uncertainty and every other type has one; an uncertainty is not negative; labels are unique; patterns are re-applied with re.fullmatch.
